border-color: var(--primary) !important; background: var(--primary-glow) !important; } .red { color: var(--danger) !important; border-color: var(--danger) !important; background: var(--danger-glow) !important; } .yellow { color: var(--warning) !important; border-color: var(--warning) !important; background: var(--warning-glow) !important; } /* Full Height Modals */ .modal-overlay { display: none; position: fixed; inset: 0; width: 100vw; height: 100dvh; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px); z-index: 9999; justify-content: center; align-items: center; padding: 16px; } .modal-overlay.active { display: flex; animation: fadeIn 0.15s ease; } @keyframes fadeIn { from { opacity: 0; } to { opacity: 1; } } .modal-body { width: 100%; max-width: 380px; max-height: 88dvh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--surface-1); border: 1px solid var(--surface-border); border-radius: 20px; padding: 16px; gap: 12px; } .rating-chips { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .rating-btn { background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--surface-border); border-radius: 12px; font-size: 20px; padding: 8px 12px; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .rating-btn.selected { border-color: var(--primary); background: var(--primary-glow); transform: scale(1.15); } .svg-chart-box { width: 100%; height: 130px; background: var(--surface-2); border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--surface-border); padding: 6px; } /* Drag handle & cards */ .drag-card { transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .drag-card.is-dragging { opacity: 0.9; transform: scale(1.02); z-index: 100; border: 1.5px solid var(--secondary); } .drag-handle { cursor: grab; color: var(--text-muted); padding: 4px; display: flex; align-items: center; }
